title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Seventh edition, Volume 13, LAB-Magnetism - EB.15
text: Soon after this the Dunes began their practical protections, and a length, after attacking the northern power of the kingdom, in 940 entered the Thames and 250 vessels, seized upon London, unilured and then burned it, and exercised their average realities on the inhabitants. A second attempt by some practical people who made, and with greater force, about two years after: but on this occasion, King Elizabeth and this son Abethelol collected a sufficient force to disappoint and finally to overcome the invaders, though the returning prosperity of London received a severe check by the attempt.
